bosses.name: Goblin King
bosses.description: A goblin with a crown, an entourage, and absolutely no restraint.

bosses.name: Hornet Empress
bosses.description: The hive has promoted its management problem directly into a raid encounter.

bosses.name: Skeleton Warlord
bosses.description: An ancient commander who has interpreted “rest in peace” as optional guidance.

bosses.name: Gigas Chief
bosses.description: A very large chief with a very small tolerance for adventurers.

bosses.name: Bomb King
bosses.description: A royal Bomb swollen with unstable fire and deeply irresponsible confidence

bosses.name: Ifrit
bosses.description: An infernal eidolon whose flames punish unprepared parties.

bosses.name: Shiva
bosses.description: An icebound eidolon that turns overconfidence into decorative frost.

bosses.name: Ramuh
bosses.description: An ancient lord of lightning who tests the Guild with thunderous judgment.

bosses.name: Ultros
bosses.description: A recurring purple nuisance with too many arms and far too much confidence.

bosses.name: Garuda
bosses.description: A violent wind eidolon whose storms make standing still an aspirational goal.

bosses.name: Titan
bosses.description: A colossal earth eidolon with a regrettable enthusiasm for tectonics.

bosses.name: Demon Wall
bosses.description: The corridor is shrinking, the wall is moving, and architecture has chosen violence.

bosses.name: Leviathan
bosses.description: The great sea serpent arrives with enough water to invalidate several maps.

bosses.name: Gilgamesh
bosses.description: A legendary weapon collector storms in from the Rift looking for worthy opponents and suspicious swords.

bosses.name: Cerberus
bosses.description: Three heads, three spells, zero respect for sensible action economy.

bosses.name: Tonberry King
bosses.description: The crown, robe and tiny knife do absolutely nothing to make this situation less threatening.

bosses.name: Deathgaze
bosses.description: A winged terror that appears where travelers were hoping for literally anything else.

bosses.name: Atomos
bosses.description: A living void that attempts to solve raid composition by simply swallowing it.

bosses.name: King Behemoth
bosses.description: A towering Behemoth monarch that considers Meteor a reasonable disagreement-resolution tool.

bosses.name: Bahamut
bosses.description: The Dragon King tests only those heroes whose insurance paperwork is already complete.

bosses.name: Death Machine Prime
bosses.description: An upgraded killing machine left running long after everyone responsible had stopped answering emails.

bosses.name: Ultima Weapon
bosses.description: An ancient weaponized abomination fueled by enough magic to make the Black Mages nervous.

bosses.name: Rift Dragon
bosses.description: A dragon twisted by the Rift, carrying enough unstable aether to upset several realities at once.

bosses.name: Warmech
bosses.description: A wandering death machine famous for arriving uninvited and leaving fewer adventurers than it found.

bosses.name: Omega
bosses.description: An interdimensional machine whose primary directive appears to be humbling max-level parties.

bosses.name: Shinryu
bosses.description: A legendary dragon from beyond the Rift that treats elemental catastrophe as a rotation.

bosses.name: Omega Weapon
bosses.description: A weapon beyond weapons; the Guild recommends bringing heroes you are emotionally prepared to lose temporarily.

bosses.name: Emerald Weapon
bosses.description: An immense Weapon awakened beneath the waves, heavily armored and deeply opposed to breathing room.

bosses.name: Ruby Weapon
bosses.description: A desert Weapon that turns party members into optional content.

bosses.name: Ozma
bosses.description: A floating sphere of cosmic hostility that has no business being this threatening.

bosses.name: Nemesis
bosses.description: A monster-arena nightmare assembled from the Guild’s worst collection habits.

bosses.name: Kaiser Dragon
bosses.description: An ancient dragon sovereign with a spell list long enough to require pagination.

bosses.name: Long Gui
bosses.description: A towering adamantoise-class titan with the approximate mobility and durability of a continent.

bosses.name: Proto-Babil
bosses.description: An ancient lunar war machine that makes Magitek technology look charmingly homemade.

bosses.name: Penance
bosses.description: A final trial accompanied by regenerating arms and absolutely no sympathy for casual preparation.

bosses.name: Absolute Virtue
bosses.description: An infamous celestial terror reserved for communities that have mistaken suffering for a group activity.

bosses.name: Yiazmat
bosses.description: An ancient elite mark built for the kind of raid where the snack break becomes part of the strategy.

items.name: Sage Staff
items.description: A well-crafted staff. A spellcasting focus built to channel sustained magical power. Requires Lv.40 and grants +71 Magic Power, +9 MAG, and +5 SPR.

items.name: Rune Blade
items.description: A well-crafted blade. A dependable front-line blade with a balanced combat profile. Etched runes reinforce its connection to magical combat. Requires Lv.40 and grants +71 Attack, +6 STR, and +3 VIT.

items.name: Magus Wand
items.description: A well-crafted wand. A compact arcane focus made for precise, efficient spellcasting. Requires Lv.40 and grants +72 Magic Power, +9 MAG, and +5 SPR.

items.name: Giant’s Axe
items.description: A rare axe for Beastmaster/Warrior/Dark Knight. Built around heavy, decisive swings rather than finesse. Requires Lv.45 and grants +78 Attack, +10 STR, and +5 VIT.

items.name: Dancing Dagger
items.description: A rare dagger for Thief/Ninja. A nimble sidearm made for fast openings and opportunistic attacks. Requires Lv.45 and grants +73 Attack, +10 DEX, and +5 LCK.

items.name: Mythril Repeater
items.description: A rare firearm for Machinist. Built to turn careful aim and good timing into reliable damage. Mythril keeps the piece strong without burdening its wielder with unnecessary weight. Requires Lv.45 and grants +76 Attack, +10 DEX, and +5 LCK.

items.name: Minstrel’s Harp
items.description: A rare battle instrument for Bard. Crafted to carry both melody and battle magic without missing a beat. Requires Lv.45 and grants +70 Attack, +70 Magic Power, +10 SPR, and +5 DEX.

items.name: Ame-no-Murakumo
items.description: A rare katana for Samurai/Ninja. Forged for control, timing, and committed strikes. Requires Lv.45 and grants +76 Attack, +9 STR, and +10 DEX.

items.name: Demon Claws
items.description: A rare set of knuckles for Monk. Built for Monks who prefer their weapons attached directly to the problem. Requires Lv.45 and grants +75 Attack, +8 STR, and +5 DEX.

items.name: Crystal Foil
items.description: A rare rapier for Red Mage/Blue Mage. A light dueling blade that leaves room for spellwork and precise footwork. Crystal reinforcement marks it as high-tier equipment for seasoned adventurers. Requires Lv.45 and grants +73 Attack, +68 Magic Power, +5 DEX, and +5 MAG.

items.name: Wyvern Lance
items.description: A rare spear for Dragoon. Balanced for clean thrusts and aggressive front-line spacing. Dragon-forged materials give it the kind of reputation that usually comes with scorch marks. Requires Lv.45 and grants +77 Attack, +10 STR, and +5 DEX.

items.name: Astral Rod
items.description: A rare staff. A caster weapon designed to keep arcane power steady under pressure. Astral materials lend it an unmistakably high-magic finish. Requires Lv.45 and grants +77 Magic Power, +10 MAG, and +5 SPR.

items.name: Breaker Blade
items.description: A rare blade. A dependable front-line blade with a balanced combat profile. Requires Lv.45 and grants +77 Attack, +7 STR, and +3 VIT.

items.name: Starfall Wand
items.description: A rare wand. A compact arcane focus made for precise, efficient spellcasting. Requires Lv.45 and grants +78 Magic Power, +10 MAG, and +5 SPR.

items.name: Mystic Wand

items.name: Stardust Wand
items.description: An exceptional wand. A dedicated caster focus that emphasizes magical control. Astral materials lend it an unmistakably high-magic finish. Requires Lv.50 and grants +83 Magic Power, +10 MAG, and +6 SPR.

items.name: Coral Sword
items.description: A rare blade. Forged for reliable melee work across a wide range of battles. Electrical affinity gives it a crackling battlefield identity. Requires Lv.30 and grants +61 Attack, +5 DEX, and +3 SPR. Basic attacks are Lightning-aspected.

items.name: Poison Fang
items.description: A rare dagger for Thief/Ninja. Compact and quick in the hand, favoring precision over reach. Requires Lv.25 and grants +53 Attack, +7 DEX, and +5 LCK. Basic attacks have an 18% chance to inflict Poison.

items.name: Fire Rod
items.description: A rare staff. Its construction favors magical output and controlled casting. Its fire-aspected construction is impossible to mistake once combat begins. Requires Lv.20 and grants +52 Magic Power, +7 MAG, and +2 SPR. Basic attacks are Fire-aspected.

items.name: Frost Rod
items.description: A rare staff. A caster weapon designed to keep arcane power steady under pressure. Cold-aspected materials give it a distinctly wintry edge. Requires Lv.25 and grants +58 Magic Power, +8 MAG, and +3 SPR. Basic attacks are Ice-aspected.

items.name: Thunder Rod
items.description: A rare staff. A spellcasting focus built to channel sustained magical power. Electrical affinity gives it a crackling battlefield identity. Requires Lv.30 and grants +64 Magic Power, +9 MAG, and +3 SPR. Basic attacks are Lightning-aspected.

items.name: Zweihander
items.description: A well-crafted blade for Warrior/Dark Knight. Forged for reliable melee work across a wide range of battles. Requires Lv.16 and grants +45 Attack, +8 STR, and +1 VIT.

items.name: Dragon Slayer
items.description: An exceptional blade for Warrior/Dark Knight. Forged for reliable melee work across a wide range of battles. Dragon-forged materials give it the kind of reputation that usually comes with scorch marks. Requires Lv.35 and grants +71 Attack, +10 STR, and +3 VIT.

items.name: Gungnir Fragment
items.description: An exceptional spear for Dragoon. Long reach and strong leverage make this polearm ideal for committed assaults. Requires Lv.45 and grants +80 Attack, +11 STR, and +7 DEX.

items.name: Blood Sword
items.description: An exceptional blade for Warrior/Dark Knight. A dependable front-line blade with a balanced combat profile. Requires Lv.40 and grants +73 Attack, +8 STR, and +4 VIT. Basic attacks restore 10% of damage dealt as HP.

items.name: Wyrmhide Coat
items.description: A well-crafted combat coat. Layered protection gives this coat a strong mix of defense and maneuverability. Dragon-forged materials give it the kind of reputation that usually comes with scorch marks. Requires Lv.40 and grants +22 VIT, +9 SPR, +5 DEX, and +195 HP.

items.name: Darksteel Plate
items.description: A well-crafted set of heavy armor. A sturdy defensive set made for adventurers expected to be hit repeatedly. Tempered steel gives it a noticeable step up in battlefield reliability. Requires Lv.40 and grants +23 VIT, +7 SPR, and +205 HP.

items.name: Shadow Garb
items.description: A well-crafted set of light armor. Protective without becoming cumbersome, leaving room for speed and finesse. Dark-toned materials give it a severe, battle-worn character. Requires Lv.40 and grants +21 VIT, +9 DEX, +5 LCK, and +185 HP.

items.name: Sage Robe
items.description: A well-crafted caster robe. A spellcaster’s defense woven for concentration, spirit, and magical output. Requires Lv.40 and grants +18 VIT, +23 SPR, +9 MAG, and +175 HP.

items.name: Dragon Coat
items.description: A rare combat coat. A flexible mid-weight defense balancing mobility and staying power. Dragon-forged materials give it the kind of reputation that usually comes with scorch marks. Requires Lv.45 and grants +23 VIT, +10 SPR, +5 DEX, and +210 HP.

items.name: Dragon Plate
items.description: A rare set of heavy armor. Built to absorb punishment and keep its wearer standing on the front line. Dragon-forged materials give it the kind of reputation that usually comes with scorch marks. Requires Lv.45 and grants +24 VIT, +8 SPR, and +220 HP.

items.name: Nightshade Garb
items.description: A rare set of light armor. A mobile defensive set built for agile combatants. Dark-toned materials give it a severe, battle-worn character. Requires Lv.45 and grants +22 VIT, +10 DEX, +5 LCK, and +200 HP.

items.name: Astral Robe
items.description: A rare caster robe. Light ceremonial armor reinforced for the less ceremonial business of surviving combat. Astral materials lend it an unmistakably high-magic finish. Requires Lv.45 and grants +19 VIT, +24 SPR, +10 MAG, and +190 HP.

items.name: Wyrm Mail
items.description: An exceptional set of heavy armor. Dense defensive plating favors durability over subtle movement. Dragon-forged materials give it the kind of reputation that usually comes with scorch marks. Requires Lv.45 and grants +26 VIT, +11 SPR, +5 STR, and +230 HP.

items.name: Genji Armor
items.description: An exceptional combat coat for Samurai/Ninja. Made for hybrid combatants who need protection without full plate. Traditional Genji workmanship emphasizes disciplined combat and elite craftsmanship. Requires Lv.45 and grants +23 VIT, +11 DEX, +7 STR, +5 LCK, and +205 HP.

items.name: Aegis Plate
items.description: An artifact-grade set of heavy armor for Paladin. Dense defensive plating favors durability over subtle movement. Requires Lv.50 and grants +29 VIT, +15 SPR, and +270 HP.

regions.name: Greenwind Plains
regions.description: Rolling fields where even the rabbits seem judgmental.

regions.name: Whispering Caverns
regions.description: Dark tunnels full of bats, crystals, and avoidable life choices.

regions.name: Sable Coast
regions.description: Salt spray, ruined docks, and Sahagin who absolutely saw you coming.

regions.name: Magitek Wastes
regions.description: A scarred mechanical deadland humming with deeply irresponsible technology.

regions.name: Crystal Expanse
regions.description: A glittering wasteland where the crystals are beautiful, valuable, and occasionally homicidal.

regions.name: Riftlands
regions.description: Reality is optional here. The monsters have noticed and are taking advantage of it.

regions.name: Interdimensional Rift
regions.description: Endgame territory. Geometry has resigned and the encounter table is actively hostile.

regions.name: Omega Ruins
regions.description: A sealed ruin where the Guild handbook simply says: perhaps do not.

quests.name: Oath of Light
quests.description: Prove you can protect people before the Guild gives you shiny armor and responsibilities.

quests.name: Abyssal Oath
quests.description: Walk into the dark on purpose. Apparently this counts as career development.

quests.name: Skybound Trial
quests.description: Earn the right to jump off perfectly good terrain while holding a spear.

quests.name: Shadow of the Guild
quests.description: Demonstrate subtlety, speed, and at least a little suspicious behavior.

quests.name: Call of the Eikons
quests.description: Balance destructive and restorative aether without detonating the guildhall.

quests.name: Aetheric Fieldwork
quests.description: Study monsters closely enough that the Guild begins questioning your hobbies.

quests.name: Song of the Wanderer
quests.description: Travel enough to have stories worth turning into songs.

quests.name: Salvage Rights
quests.description: Bring back enough Magitek junk that someone reluctantly hands you a firearm.

quests.name: Wisdom of the Crystal
quests.description: Master opposing schools of magic and prove the Crystal has not made a terrible choice.

titles.name: Fresh Meat
titles.description: Newly recruited. The paperwork is still damp.

titles.name: Monster Botherer
titles.description: Defeated something that probably wanted to be left alone.

titles.name: Certified Floor Inspector
titles.description: Extensive professional experience with the ground.

titles.name: Needle Dodger
titles.description: Mostly successful at not becoming a pincushion.

titles.name: Grudge Survivor
titles.description: A Tonberry remembers. Unfortunately, so do you.

titles.name: Bomb Disposal Officer
titles.description: The Guild's definition of disposal is surprisingly violent.

titles.name: Tidebreaker
titles.description: Sahagin royalty has filed a formal complaint.

titles.name: Needle Threader
titles.description: Caught the fast green bastard.

titles.name: Cat Problem Solver
titles.description: Solved a very large, electrified cat problem.

titles.name: Blade Witness
titles.description: Saw the Riven Ronin draw. Somehow still here.

titles.name: Fresh Air Advocate
titles.description: Has opinions about Malboro breath.

titles.name: Giant Feller
titles.description: Turns out they do fall down.

titles.name: Moonbreaker
titles.description: Three heads. Still not enough.

titles.name: Still Not Stabbed
titles.description: The lantern got close. Too close.

titles.name: Warranty Voider
titles.description: Magitek maintenance declined to comment.

titles.name: Behemoth Botherer
titles.description: A lifestyle choice with poor actuarial outcomes.

titles.name: Geological Incident
titles.description: Defeated something that was basically terrain.

titles.name: Riftwalker
titles.description: Went beyond the veil and came back with loot.

titles.name: Oathkeeper
titles.description: Completed the Oath of Light.

titles.name: Abyss Walker
titles.description: Stared into the abyss. It asked you to stop staring.

titles.name: Skybound
titles.description: Gravity is now more of a suggestion.

titles.name: Shadowstep
titles.description: Definitely standing behind you right now.

titles.name: Aethercaller
titles.description: Has extremely powerful imaginary friends.

titles.name: Aetheric Field Researcher
titles.description: Monster science, with considerably more hitting.

titles.name: Wandering Minstrel
titles.description: Has enough road stories to make the rest of the tavern nervous.

titles.name: Licensed Tinkerer
titles.description: The license is mostly decorative.

titles.name: Crystal Scholar
titles.description: Knows enough magic to become everyone else's problem.

titles.name: Master of One
titles.description: Mastered a Job to level 50.

titles.name: Mark Hunter
titles.description: Cleared ten Hunts.

titles.name: S-Rank Problem
titles.description: Defeated an S-Rank mark. Concerningly enthusiastic about doing it again.

titles.name: Guild Artisan
titles.description: Craft 25 items.

titles.name: Hammer Time
titles.description: Complete 10 forge upgrades.

titles.name: Relic Bearer
titles.description: Complete your first Zenith Relic.

titles.name: Rift Delver
titles.description: Reach the Interdimensional Rift.

titles.name: Certified Tent Inspector
titles.description: Has spent enough time at camp to have opinions about tent stakes.

titles.name: Strength in Numbers
titles.description: Answers enough encounter rallies that solo adventuring now feels suspicious.

titles.name: Phoenix Wrangler
titles.description: Has revived enough raid members to qualify as emergency services.

titles.name: Limit Break Enthusiast
titles.description: Believes every problem can be solved by waiting for the gauge to glow.

titles.name: Seasoned Wayfarer
titles.description: Has been outside so long the Guild stopped expecting a timely return.

titles.name: World-Worn
titles.description: Every road has a story. Most of them involve monsters and questionable snacks.

titles.name: Crystal Veteran
titles.description: Has survived enough adventures to become part of the scenery.

titles.name: Legend in Residence
titles.description: Reached the level cap. The Guild has run out of sensible advice.

titles.name: Monster Menace
titles.description: Local wildlife has begun filing incident reports.

titles.name: Ecological Incident
titles.description: A statistically concerning number of monsters are no longer with us.

titles.name: Damage Dealer
titles.description: Numbers go up. Monsters go down. Accounting remains nervous.

titles.name: Walking Calculation Error
titles.description: Damage totals have become a threat to spreadsheet stability.

titles.name: Big Number Enjoyer
titles.description: Believes punctuation in damage numbers is a moral victory.

titles.name: Guild Paramedic
titles.description: Has restored enough HP to qualify for extremely unofficial medical credentials.

titles.name: Floor Tank
titles.description: Aggressively controls the horizontal plane.

titles.name: Professional Floor Tank
titles.description: The floor knows you by name.

titles.name: Monster Librarian
titles.description: Catalogues wildlife by repeatedly hitting it.

titles.name: Walking Bestiary
titles.description: Knows every monster in the catalog and several of their legal representatives.

titles.name: Everyone’s Grudge
titles.description: Has made the Tonberry community collectively aware of their existence.

titles.name: Breath Taker
titles.description: Has spent far too much time near Malboros and somehow still has opinions.

titles.name: Hunt Board Terror
titles.description: The Hunt Board updates itself when you walk into the room.

titles.name: Mark of Marks
titles.description: The marks are beginning to post bounties on you.

titles.name: S-Rank Repeat Offender
titles.description: One S-Rank was apparently not enough evidence.

titles.name: Polymath
titles.description: Mastered enough Jobs to make specialization look optional.

titles.name: Every Job Is My Main Job
titles.description: Mastered the entire Job roster. Please choose a personality.

titles.name: Career Adventurer
titles.description: Has put in enough combat hours to request benefits. Request denied.

titles.name: Gil Hoarder
titles.description: Can hear a dropped coin from three regions away.

titles.name: Gil Tycoon
titles.description: Has enough gil to begin making deeply irresponsible purchasing decisions.

titles.name: Economic Stimulus
titles.description: Personally responsible for keeping several Moogles employed.

titles.name: Master Artisan
titles.description: Crafted enough equipment to start criticizing other people’s hammer technique.

titles.name: Anvil Abuser
titles.description: The blacksmith has asked you to stop making eye contact with the forge.

titles.name: Relic Collector
titles.description: One legendary weapon was not sufficiently dramatic.

titles.name: Arsenal of Legend
titles.description: Completed every Relic line. Storage space has become theoretical.

titles.name: Raid Regular
titles.description: Shows up when the boss music starts instead of leaving like a sensible person.

titles.name: World Saver, Part-Time
titles.description: Has saved the world often enough that it should really be salaried.

titles.name: Eikon on Speed Dial
titles.description: Summons ancient powers with the casual confidence of ordering takeout.

titles.name: Gauge Watcher
titles.description: Has stared at the Limit bar long enough to see through time.

titles.name: Phoenix Dispatcher
titles.description: Runs an unofficial resurrection logistics department.

titles.name: Boss Botherer
titles.description: Has defeated enough bosses that dramatic entrances are losing their effect.

titles.name: Professional Problem
titles.description: Supernatural threats have begun recognizing the username.

titles.name: Judged and Found Annoying
titles.description: Penance rendered judgment. You objected successfully.

titles.name: Contract Violator
titles.description: Yiazmat had a health bar. You treated it as a suggestion.

titles.name: Absolutely Unreasonable
titles.description: Defeated Absolute Virtue. The name of this title is also the diagnosis.

titles.name: Grudge Magnet
titles.description: Tonberries keep finding you. At this point, consider changing your number.

titles.name: Breath Test Failure
titles.description: Has been KO’d by Malboro enough times to identify Bad Breath by vintage.

titles.name: Tent Landlord
titles.description: Has spent enough nights camping to demand zoning rights.

titles.name: Party Animal
titles.description: Has joined enough rallies to make solo play feel suspicious.

titles.name: Goblin Negotiator
titles.description: Negotiations were brief, loud, and conducted with weapons.

titles.name: Packbreaker
titles.description: The Alpha howled. You answered with paperwork and violence.

titles.name: Royal Pest Control
titles.description: Handled a queen-sized stinging problem without a very large rolled newspaper.

titles.name: Bone to Pick
titles.description: You had one. The skeleton had considerably more.

achievements.name: Master of One
achievements.description: Master any Job at Job Level 50.

achievements.name: Union Approved
achievements.description: Craft 25 items without setting the Guild on fire.

achievements.name: Past the Edge of Reason
achievements.description: Reach Character Lv.70 and become ready for the Interdimensional Rift.

achievements.name: Happy Camper
achievements.description: Rest at camp 10 times. At this point the tent is basically real estate.

achievements.name: Party People
achievements.description: Join or start 25 random party encounters.

achievements.name: One Big Number
achievements.description: Land a single hit for at least 5,000 damage.

achievements.name: No Stone Unstabbed
achievements.description: Discover every monster species in the Bestiary.

achievements.name: Punch the Clock
achievements.description: Fight 100 battles on a single Job.

achievements.name: There Is No Solo in Party
achievements.description: Join or start 100 random party encounters.
